title: Rammstein - Amerika (Official 4K Video)
summary: The official music video for Rammstein's 2004 song Amerika, a satirical take on American cultural dominance and its export around the world. It was shot in the ruins of a former chemical site near Berlin.
why: HN mostly cites it as a pop-culture reference in discussions of American cultural influence, sometimes jokingly.

quote.text: Their point is that the USA _exports_ its culture to the rest of the world
